svg.aria-label: Suspicious mole. The ABCDE warning signs: asymmetry, irregular border, varied color, diameter over 6 millimeters, evolving. Then a skin cross-section showing a narrow excisional biopsy with 1 to 3 millimeter margins that includes the full depth of the lesion, the Breslow depth measurement, and a shallow shave that would cut through the tumor.

tspan.tspan: margins, full depth of the lesion.
Partial biopsy only in selected cases (e.g.,
face, acral skin, very large lesions).
A shave or cut through the tumor base
